question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Burn the midnight oil

options.text: To work late into the night

solution:
The correct answer is:** To work late into the night**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Burn the midnight oil"** means to work late into the night, usually to study or complete some task. (रात देर तक काम करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She had to burn the midnight oil to finish the project on time.
 
 
 
• **To work late into the night** refers to extending one's working hours late into the night, often to complete an urgent task or meet a deadline. (रात देर तक काम करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He often works late into the night to keep up with his busy schedule.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**
